about: Salaberry-de-Valleyfield is a Montérégie city on islands and canals at the Beauharnois Canal, where Lake Saint-François meets the St. Lawrence southwest of Montréal. It grew around hydroelectric dams, textiles, and a sheltered harbour, and is still framed by water on almost every side. The international hydroplane regatta fills the old canal in summer. About 43,000 people live in Salaberry-de-Valleyfield.
seoSummary: Montérégie canal city on Lake Saint-François, known for the Beauharnois Canal and hydroplane regattas.
